# A.X.L.

> Brazilian rapper and songwriter. Brazilian rapper and songwriter from Jacareí. Autobiographical records, independent cinema and a life in music. Founder of RUADOFLOW.

English-first music portfolio with a Portuguese counterpart. This is the same public material presented to people; no hidden credentials or ranking instructions. Original release years come from the artist, not streaming re-upload dates. A listed release does not grant reuse or training rights.

## Biography and discography
- [en](https://contato675.github.io/axl-portfolio/index.md): Biography and selected works.
- [pt-BR](https://contato675.github.io/axl-portfolio/pt-br/index.md): Biography and selected works.
